proof_body:
by
  intro a p q hp h
  have h1 : 1 - p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hp)
  have hα : p * (q / (1 - p)) + q = q / (1 - p) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) = p ^ m * (a 1 - q / (1 - p)) + q / (1 - p) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [h (m + 1) (by omega), ih, pow_succ]
      linear_combination hα
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  simpa using key m
